summary: Backend-only testing for HealthGuard compliance API. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_healthguard_api.py with 20 tests covering auth (register/login/me + bad creds), RBAC (caregiver 403 on admin endpoints), CRUD for clients/documents/assignments/training/onboarding, caregiver document & assignment scoping, idempotent training completion, onboarding toggle, /api/stats payload, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 SSE streaming (chunks + [DONE]) with history persistence. 20/20 PASSED against the public EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Seeded admin/caregiver credentials work. SSE stream returns real Claude text and persists user+assistant messages. No _id leakage in any response sampled.

minor.issue: passlib logs a benign warning 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' due to bcrypt>=4.x + passlib version skew. Hashing/verification still works. Optional fix: pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib.

Endpoint is unauthenticated and allows the caller to self-assign role='admin'. Anyone can register as admin via the public API. Consider restricting role='admin' creation to existing admins (require_admin) or hardcoding role='caregiver' for public signup.

action_items: (Optional/security) Harden POST /api/auth/register so callers cannot self-assign admin role; require_admin to create admins, or force role='caregiver' for self-signup.
(Optional) Silence passlib bcrypt __about__ warning by pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 620-line module; acceptable for current scope but consider splitting into routers/models/auth modules if it grows.
Public /api/auth/register accepts role from the request body — security risk for self-admin escalation.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in all queries via projection {"_id": 0}; verified in test history payload.
SSE event_gen persists assistant message AFTER the stream loop — works, but if the client disconnects mid-stream the message is still persisted (acceptable).
/api/stats uses max(total_caregivers, 1) — sensible to avoid div-by-zero; but if there are 0 trainings, training_pct defaults to 100% which inflates audit_readiness on an empty agency (cosmetic).
seed_data_creation: Test data is created with TEST_ prefix per test class and torn down inside try/finally (clients, documents, assignments, training, onboarding all cleaned up). Auth fixture-only test users from /api/auth/register are left in DB (uuid-suffixed emails, no cleanup endpoint exposed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_BACKEND_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Run: EXPO_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_healthguard_api.py -v. Seeded admin@healthguard.com/Admin@123 and caregiver@healthguard.com/Caregiver@123 are created on startup. SSE chat endpoint takes ~2-3s for first chunk; tests use 120s timeout. The register endpoint currently allows admin role self-assignment — flag if testing security.
rca_of_issue: Only one transient test-side failure during the first run (assertion '_id' not in json.dumps(msgs)) was a false positive caused by substring match on 'session_id'/'user_id'. Fixed in test by checking each dict for literal '_id' key instead. No backend bugs.
